entries.title: Man sentenced 40 years for 2022 murder of beloved Hyde Park bartender
entries.summary: <p>A Chicago man was sentenced to 40 years in prison for the 2022 murder of a beloved Hyde Park bartender.</p><p>Keante McShan, 23, pleaded guilty to the murder and armed robbery of Diego Damis on Thursday. He was handed a sentence of 40 years by Judge John Lyke Jr., according to Cook County court records.</p><p>Damis was a bartender at The Cove Lounge in Hyde Park, where the Italian immigrant was known for his generosity and kind heart. Loved ones <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/obituaries/2022/2/28/22955298/diego-damis-dead-obituary-bartender-cove-lounge-kenwood-hyde-park-obama-mansion-greenwood" target="_blank" ><u>said he would bring</u></a> home-cooked Italian meals to the bar and offer people in need a place to stay.</p><p>Damis was on his way home when he was stabbed to death in the 4900 block of South Greenwood Avenue on Feb. 25, 2022, around 5 a.m. He was 41.</p><p>Damis <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/crime/2022/3/6/22964822/hyde-park-bartender-diego-damis-stabbed-keane-mcshan-charged-murder" target="_blank" ><u>was headed home after a shift</u></a> at the Cove Lounge and had been paid in cash. Video surveillance shows he was followed by McShan, then 18, who had been checking for unlocked cars in the area, prosecutors alleged.</p><p>Prosecutors said McShan used a knife to stab Damis several times in the early hours of February 25, and then ran away with his wallet and bank card. He used the card to purchase cigarettes at a nearby gas station, according to prosecutors.</p><div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="Enhancement-item" data-crop=""> <figure class="Figure"><a class="AnchorLink" id="image-ef0000" name="image-ef0000"></a> <picture data-crop="medium"> <source type="image/webp" width="490" height="275" data-srcset="https://cst.brightspotcdn.com/dims4/default/e4f55ca/2147483647/strip/true/crop/1434x805+0+74/resize/490x275!/format/webp/quality/90/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fchorus-production-cst-web.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com%2Fbrightspot%2F8a%2F9f%2Fe6ef6807a3fab9fdfcd3ccf82d6b%2Fscreen-shot-2022-03-07-at-10-44-56-am.png 1x,https://cst.brightspotcdn.com/dims4/default/acc4c55/2147483647/strip/true/crop/1434x805+0+74/resize/980x550!/format/webp/quality/90/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fchorus-production-cst-web.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com%2Fbrightspot%2F8a%2F9f%2Fe6ef6807a3fab9fdfcd3ccf82d6b%2Fscreen-shot-2022-03-07-at-10-44-56-am.png 2x" data-lazy-load="true" srcset="data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHZlcnNpb249IjEuMSIgaGVpZ2h0PSIyNzVweCIgd2lkdGg9IjQ5MHB4Ij48L3N2Zz4=" /> <source width="490" height="275" data-srcset="https://cst.brightspotcdn.com/dims4/default/be5029e/2147483647/strip/true/crop/1434x805+0+74/resize/490x275!/quality/90/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fchorus-production-cst-web.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com%2Fbrightspot%2F8a%2F9f%2Fe6ef6807a3fab9fdfcd3ccf82d6b%2Fscreen-shot-2022-03-07-at-10-44-56-am.png" data-lazy-load="true" srcset="data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHZlcnNpb249IjEuMSIgaGVpZ2h0PSIyNzVweCIgd2lkdGg9IjQ5MHB4Ij48L3N2Zz4=" /> <img class="Image" alt="Diego Damis, 41, holds his niece. He was the victim of a fatal stabbing in Kenwood Feb. 25.</p></figcaption></div> </figure> </div> </div><p>Surveillance footage was used to track McShan from the crime scene to his home. Police said a knife and the stolen cards were found at his residence.</p><p>Police records revealed that McShan had pending juvenile cases for theft, firearm possession and unlawful use of a weapon. He also had a warrant for juvenile aggravated vehicular hijacking and unlawful use of a weapon from 2021.</p><p>McShan received credit for the time served in prison since a March 2022 arrest.</p><p>Court records show that McShan is set to enter a plea in two additional cases on Sept. 10.</p><p>In one case, McShan faced a charge of aggravated battery of a peace officer stemming from a May 2024 incident, filed in August 2024. According to the indictment, while in custody, McShan threw a container of urine at a correctional institutional employee. He pleaded not guilty in 2024.</p><p>Another case, filed in April 2024, charges McShan and four co-defendants with kidnapping and <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/crime/2020/9/3/21421376/romel-tyson-murder-charge-markham-grandparents" target="_blank" ><u>battery of a fellow inmate</u></a>, Romel Tyson, on Sept. 3, 2023. McShan pleaded not guilty that same year, court records show.</p>

entries.title: Boy, 13, critically wounded after being shot by 9-year-old in Fuller Park
entries.summary: <p>A 13-year-old boy is in critical condition after being shot by another child on Friday afternoon in Fuller Park.</p><p>Police said a 9-year-old boy was inside a home in the 4200 block of South Wells Street with a firearm. He reportedly fired one shot around 4 p.m. on Friday, hitting a 13-year-old boy in the shoulder. </p><p>The wounded boy was taken to the University of Chicago Medical Center, where he was in critical condition. </p><p>A handgun was found at the scene, police said. Detectives are investigating the shooting. </p>
